boards.title: Your First Weekend at Mount Carmel College of Nursing, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure first-weekend sequence that begins on MCCN’s Columbus campus and branches into documented downtown learning, culture, and public spaces.

cards.title: Get oriented at the Center for Learning and Education
cards.subtitle: Mount Carmel College of Nursing main campus
cards.notes: Start by locating the CLE and taking a slow lap around the main campus so classrooms and everyday student spaces feel familiar.
cards.short_summary: Begin with a practical campus orientation stop.
cards.evidence_claim: MCCN’s main Columbus campus offers undergraduate and graduate programs, with classes and clinicals on campus.
cards.access_notes: Main campus address: 127 South Davis Ave., Columbus, OH 43222.

cards.title: Pause at Charlie’s Java Jolt
cards.subtitle: Center for Learning and Education, MCCN
cards.notes: Use this campus coffee-shop stop for a snack or beverage, then check your weekend plan before heading to the next destination.
cards.short_summary: A named on-campus option for a quick refreshment.
cards.evidence_claim: MCCN identifies Charlie’s Java Jolt in the Center for Learning and Education as a coffee shop offering snacks, deli sandwiches, sweet treats, and beverages.
cards.source_title: Student Life at MCCN Q & A
cards.access_notes: Food and beverages are available for purchase; campus access may be limited to the MCCN community.

cards.title: Settle in at the Marian Hall Lounge
cards.subtitle: Mount Carmel College of Nursing main campus
cards.notes: Bring a meal or notes and use the lounge as a calm regrouping point; it is a simple place to connect before going downtown.
cards.short_summary: A campus lounge for an unhurried reset.
cards.evidence_claim: MCCN states that students are welcome to eat in the Marian Hall lounge.
cards.source_title: Student Life at MCCN Q & A
cards.access_notes: MCCN identifies the lounge as a student eating space; bring your own meal if desired.

cards.title: Find your study base at the Health Sciences Library
cards.subtitle: Mount Carmel College of Nursing campus
cards.notes: Make a short visit to identify the library and its study setup now, so you know where to return when coursework gets busy.
cards.short_summary: Locate a named academic resource early.
cards.evidence_claim: MCCN’s student-housing information lists access to the Mount Carmel Health Sciences Library during designated hours.
cards.source_title: Mount Carmel College of Nursing Student Housing Application
cards.access_notes: Library access is during designated hours; confirm current access procedures before visiting.

cards.title: Look into Student Senate
cards.subtitle: Mount Carmel College of Nursing student activity
cards.notes: Check how Student Senate communicates upcoming opportunities and save its information; it is a direct way to learn how students organize campus life.
cards.short_summary: An early connection point for campus involvement.
cards.evidence_claim: MCCN lists Student Senate among activities in which its students may participate.
cards.source_title: Student Life at MCCN Q & A
cards.access_notes: Participation details and meeting arrangements should be confirmed with MCCN Student Life.

cards.title: Walk a stretch of the Scioto Mile
cards.subtitle: Downtown Columbus riverfront
cards.notes: Choose a daylight section of the riverfront path for a relaxed walk and skyline views, then use the connected parks as an easy orientation to downtown.
cards.short_summary: A public riverfront walk that links downtown parks.
cards.evidence_claim: The Scioto Trail runs along the Scioto River from North Bank Park to Bicentennial Park and forms the spine of the Scioto Mile.
cards.access_notes: Use the trail in daylight and follow posted park and trail guidance.

cards.title: Take a Statehouse tour
cards.subtitle: 1 Capitol Square, downtown Columbus
cards.notes: Arrive a few minutes before an hourly tour and begin at the Map Room; use the visit to learn the layout of Capitol Square.
cards.short_summary: A free, structured downtown history stop.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ohio Statehouse offers free guided tours daily except state holidays, with self-guided visits also available.
cards.access_notes: Weekday walk-in tours begin hourly from 10 a.m. through 3 p.m.; weekend tours begin at noon, 1, 2, and 3 p.m. Confirm holiday closures.

cards.title: Explore hands-on science at COSI
cards.subtitle: 333 West Broad Street, Columbus
cards.notes: Choose a few exhibit areas instead of rushing the whole building, and check the day’s calendar before leaving campus for current availability.
cards.short_summary: A large science center with interactive exhibits.
cards.evidence_claim: COSI describes its classic and permanent exhibition areas as included with general admission or membership.
cards.access_notes: General admission or membership is required for the described exhibits; availability can vary by daily schedule.

cards.title: Browse Main Library
cards.subtitle: 96 South Grant Avenue, downtown Columbus
cards.notes: Use the Main Library as a quiet afternoon stop: browse, find a seat, or ask staff about its local-history and research resources.
cards.short_summary: A downtown public-library stop for reading and research.
cards.evidence_claim: Columbus Metropolitan Library invites visitors to Main Library for in-person local history and genealogy research help.
cards.access_notes: Main Library is at 96 S. Grant Ave.; check the library’s current location page for hours and service availability.

cards.entity_name: The Book Loft of German Village
cards.title: End with a Book Loft browse
cards.subtitle: 631 South Third Street, German Village
cards.notes: Leave time to wander the bookstore’s many rooms and pick a reading nook for a low-key final stop before heading back to campus.
cards.short_summary: A named independent bookstore in historic German Village.
cards.evidence_claim: The Book Loft says its Columbus German Village store occupies 32 rooms and is open 10 a.m.–11 p.m. seven days a week.
cards.source_title: The Book Loft of German Village
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 10 a.m.–11 p.m. daily; verify before travel, particularly around holidays or special events.
